annotation.title_clean: National AI Impact Programme: Empowering Enterprises and Workers to Transform with AI (Factsheet)
annotation.title_en: National AI Impact Programme: Empowering Enterprises and Workers to Transform with AI (Factsheet)
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Ministry of Digital Development and Information (MDDI), Singapore
annotation.summary_en: Singapore MDDI factsheet announcing the National AI Impact Programme at the 2026 Committee of Supply debates, supporting 10,000 enterprises and 100,000 AI-bilingual workers through training, pre-approved AI solutions with grants, and accountancy and legal sector partnerships. It has no robotics content.
key_provisions_or_claims: Supports 10,000 enterprises over three years in AI adoption
Aims to make 100,000 workers AI Bilingual
Digital Leaders Accelerator Bootcamp for business leaders
Raise AI-enabled share of pre-approved Productivity Solutions Grant solutions from 30% to 50%
TeSA expanded for accountancy and legal professionals, launching 1H 2026
